params.name: collectionIds
params.description: Collection IDs to show alerts for. Obtain collection IDs from GET /public/v1/collections. If empty and showAllAlerts is false, no alerts will be returned.

params.name: showAllAlerts
params.description: If true, show all accessible alerts and ignore the collectionIds parameter. If false, only alerts for the specified collections are returned.

params.name: countryId
params.description: Country ID to filter alerts by. Obtain country IDs from the infotags endpoint (GET /public/v1/infotags) filtered by location type. Note: Country codes are not currently supported; use country ID instead.

params.name: includeGeo
params.description: If set to true, the response will include the geo information.

params.name: bound
params.description: Bounding box defining the geographic area to search. Format: bound=xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax. Example: bound=16.0,48.0,16.5,48.5

params.name: previousBound
params.description: Previous bounding box for incremental updates. Used to optimize queries when updating a map view.

items.docs:
### Overview
Retrieve alerts displayed on the disruption map filtered by geographic region, collections, and other criteria.

This endpoint returns alerts that are visible on the disruption map interface, allowing you to query
alerts by geographic bounding boxes, collections, countries, and various filter criteria.

### Response
Returns an array of alert objects. Each alert includes basic information (id, uuid, title, timestamps),
